The core holding in every client account is the Meridian Balanced Fund. For the periods ending December 31, 2025 the fund returned 9.6% for 1 year, 6.9% per year for 5 years, and 7.4% per year for 10 years before my advisory fee, and 8.5%, 5.8%, and 6.3% after the 1.00% annual advisory fee every client pays; fund-level expenses are already reflected in both sets of figures. The fund has only one share class, so the figures apply to every client; clients hold whichever of its several share classes their custodian makes available. Past performance does not guarantee future results, and investments may lose value.
